records.title: Cursed-Blood Pot
records.description:
Cursed-Blood Pot is a throwable Ritual Pot item in Elden Ring.
Summoned Spirit Ashes become significantly more aggressive to enemies hit with this pot's AOE, prioritizing them over other enemies and attacking much more frequently. Affected spirits gain red glowing eyes during the duration of the effect.
If the pot is thrown away from enemies, it appears summoned spirits will run towards the AOE until they reach it, at which point they will gain the glowing eyes and resume targeting enemies as normal — suggesting that the pot can make spirits more aggressive even if no enemies are hit; more testing is needed.

records.title: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing
records.description:
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing is a Key Item in Elden Ring.
There are 4 different versions of this item, each with a respective adjunct. They can be given to the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold.
* Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] gives access to: Smithing Stone 1, Smithing Stone 2 and Glintstone Scrap. Dropped by the Crystalian miniboss at the end of the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
* Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] gives access to: Smithing Stone 3, Smithing Stone 4 and Explosive Stone. Found in a chest within the Sealed Tunnel behind an illusory wall.
* Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] gives access to: Smithing Stone 5 and Smithing Stone 6. Found at the Zamor Ruins on the Mountaintops of the Giants.
* Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] gives access to: Smithing Stone 7, Smithing Stone 8. Found in Crumbling Farum Azula, dropped by the Godskin Duo boss.
* Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing, the equivalent for Somber Smithing Stones
* Smithing Stones, the collection page for all upgrade materials granted by this item
